description: Self management 102 , be clear and direct #selflove #stewardship #criticalthinking
transcript: I am very playful, but I do not play games when it comes to myself. If I allow you to overstep my boundaries, I am training myself to think that that behavior is okay. I'm very, very, very firm on my boundaries, on my rules. I'm very clear. I'm very direct. Communication is important to me in everything that I do. I have to be very clear about what my offerings are and what my standards are.
